name: features-10
description: Top 10 most important product features ranked by consumer relevance.
system_prompt_additions: Select and return EXACTLY 10 features. Prioritize by consumer impact: performance specs first, then build quality, then convenience features. Each feature should be a concise phrase naming the feature and its benefit. If fewer than 10 features are found in the source data, fill remaining slots with the best inferred general benefits — but do not fabricate specific numbers or specs.

output_schema.model_number: string | null — manufacturer part or model number
features: string — top feature 10 (least critical of the top 10)
